title: Tenant Operating System Studio Convergence Contracts

phases.objective: Provide a repository-native convergence specification whose package, installation, lifecycle, Work Map, candidate-PR classification, no-secret, and truthful completion contracts validate from the exact candidate tree without granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec-local deterministic validator from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The declared file inventory, JSON/OpenAPI contracts, candidate convergence, Work Map classification, completion state, and no-secret boundaries pass as one structured report.
steps: Validate the exact manifest inventory and specification-only boundaries.
Validate the package, installation, lifecycle, candidate-convergence, and draft OpenAPI contract structure.
Validate PR #3922 and PR #4432 classification into generic substrate and bounded reference packages.
Validate all 19 Work Maps and 16 schema domains have explicit decisions while runtime implementation remains blocked.
Validate completion truthfulness and scan the complete Spec directory for prohibited secret patterns.
assertions: The report declares ok=true, mutation_authority_granted=false, runtime_implementation_claimed=false, and secrets_included=false.
PR #3922 and PR #4432 remain reconstruct-on-current-main sources rather than blindly merged canonical Specs.
Specification completion cannot be interpreted as runtime, migration, provider, deployment, or Production completion.

phases.objective: Implement package/component registries, deterministic installation compilation, custom entities, lifecycles, forms, file policies, AI definitions, and generated tenant-safe surfaces through bounded child PRs.
blockers: The field-level current-main reuse matrix is not complete.
The package registry mapping and custom entity persistence decisions remain open.
Duplicate Spec 014 identity and candidate extraction paths require review.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Tenant system designer and package reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Create and compile a private tenant package with entities, forms, lifecycle, workflow, file, UI, and acceptance components
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The package validates, installs for an exact Brand in sandbox, produces a deterministic installation revision, and exposes tenant-safe generated surfaces without creating implicit authority.
steps: Create immutable package and component versions through existing platform authorities.
Compile the exact target installation with lineage, conflicts, revision vector, and deterministic hash.
Run sandbox acceptance and prove UI/form/resource authority remains server-enforced.

phases.objective: Prove upgrades, rollback, provider/manual fallback, backup/restore, drift reconciliation, delegation revocation, export, and handover continuity.
blockers: Operational package and installation runtime is not implemented.
Reference packages and agency/client delegation journeys are not reconstructed.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Agency operator, client owner, and release reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Upgrade one client installation with local overrides, simulate dependency degradation, and execute a client handover
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Three-way conflicts are explicit, rollback is verified, agency delegation is revoked, and the client-owned system continues under client principals.
steps: Run three-way package upgrade and block ambiguous local customization conflicts.
Exercise manual/provider fallback, backup/restore, and prior-revision rollback.
Transfer or recreate client-owned dependencies, revoke delegation, and verify continuity plus former-agency denial.

phases.objective: Run bounded pilots for a freelancer, an agency with two client Brands, a client-owned Tenant with agency delegation, Evidence Intelligence, and Retail Commerce reference packages.
blockers: Operational and resilient acceptance suites are incomplete.
Pilot Tenants, Brands, packages, allowed effect classes, budgets, and stop rules are not approved.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized pilot tenants, client reviewers, and platform operators
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Author, install, activate, and operate bounded package installations in approved pilot cohorts
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The intended tenant models operate with strict isolation, usable generated surfaces, measurable health/cost, manual fallback, rollback, and handover readiness.
steps: Pilot one freelancer-created system and one agency package installed for two isolated client Brands.
Pilot a client-owned Tenant with delegated agency access and tested revocation.
Run Evidence Intelligence and Retail Commerce reference packages under package-specific acceptance gates.

phases.objective: Verify governed migrations, Production runtime and generated-surface parity, health, isolation, backup/restore, rollback, support, handover, and truthful closeout.
blockers: Canary acceptance and Production release authority do not exist.
No package runtime migration, deployment, Production canary, or post-merge audit has been executed.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized release operator and tenant pilot owners
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact verified release candidate through the governed deployment and migration path
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production runs the intended package and installation revisions with current contracts, healthy runtime/surfaces, strict tenant/client isolation, fallback, rollback, handover continuity, and complete closeout evidence.
steps: Verify exact-head CI, applied migration evidence, main/Production parity, and active feature/package configuration.
Run bounded Production health, generated-surface, isolation, provider/manual fallback, and rollback readback.
Complete post-merge audit and classify all remaining work explicitly.
